losses.description: Games the engine under test lost

wins.description: Games the engine under test won

elo0.description: The Elo of H0, which rejection favors

elo1.description: The Elo of H1, which acceptance favors

threads.description: The threads each engine searches with

description: Return the newest events, newest first: optionally only those of a run, of an author or of a kind, those older than a time, those that match a filter in the /api/actions language, a field matched against a constant or a comparison ($eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin) combined with $and, $or and $nor, and those holding some words. A string matches whole and case-sensitively, and a time is in seconds since the Unix epoch; the last event's time, passed as before, reads the events older than it. A selection by run, author, kind or time reads an index.
